title: A supercongruence related to Whipple's ${}_5F_4$ formula and Dwork's dash operation
summary: We establish a parametric supercongruence related to Whipple's ${}_5F_4$ formula and Dwork's dash operation. As a typical consequence, we obtain the following result: for any prime $p\equiv3\pmod4$ and odd integer $r\geq1$, $$ \sum_{k=0}^{p^r-1}(8k+1)\frac{(\frac14)_k^3(\frac12)_k}{(1)_k^3(\frac34)_k}\equiv 3p^r+\frac{27p^{3r}}{4}H_{(p^r-3)/4}^{(2)}\pmod{p^{r+3}}, $$ where $(x)_n=x(x+1)\cdots(x+n-1)$ is the Pochhammer symbol and $H_n^{(2)}=\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{1}{k^2}$ is the $n$-th harmonic number of order $2$.
